title: Guard at Ironhollow Fading Signal while miners of ours gather iron there; docks at The Experiment
note: 2026-11-17 00:14 UTC (Apophis): written on Zero's request (requests.log ENT-174). Guards gather-ironhollow-fading-signal: up to 7 miners at once, 45-minute runs, the field one jump from The Experiment, so the miners spend most of a run at the field (the first guard route watched a field whose station lay six jumps away and saw its miner in 11 of 61 looks). Ironhollow is lawless; combat drones of a foreign faction were met there (data/intel/met.json). The guard never fires; it leaves under 60 percent hull, in a fight, after 60 minutes or when no miner of ours flies the route. Standing work: judged on what it sees, not on its pay.
